evidence.description: Unverified model assertion: spec.md written (271 lines) capturing R01 as FR-002..FR-005
Unverified model assertion: grep confirms 10 FR entries and template section order in spec.md

falsification_tests: A valid batch returns a non-insert ID or wrong order; empty input returns non-empty; a malformed op (unknown op, non-mapping document, non-positive doc_id) does not raise ValueError.
claims.text: apply(operations) accepts a list of operation dicts (insert {'op':'insert','document':dict} or remove {'op':'remove','doc_id':positive int}), returns the list of inserted document IDs in order (removes add nothing), returns [] for empty input, and raises ValueError for unknown/malformed operations.

evidence.description: Unverified model assertion: spec.md written capturing R02 as FR-006..FR-008 (atomicity, missing-ID error, handle reflection)
Unverified model assertion: grep confirms Functional Requirements section present with 10 FR entries

falsification_tests: A batch that fails at operation k leaves earlier inserts/removes applied (partial state); a missing-ID remove does not error; a pre-acquired handle shows stale state after success or rollback.
claims.text: Batch application is atomic: operations are validated and applied sequentially, and on any error the complete pre-batch default-table data is restored; a remove targeting a missing ID is an error; previously acquired db.table('_default') handles reflect both success and rollback.

falsification_tests: An ordinary read/write behaves differently with a BatchWriter present; a preexisting document becomes unreadable; mutating the caller's operation dict or returned nested data after apply changes the stored document.
claims.text: Ordinary TinyDB reads/writes and preexisting documents continue to work with a BatchWriter in use; inserted and returned nested data must not alias the caller's input; mutating an operation after apply cannot mutate the database.
